data.status: fetched via Fandom api.php (curl); from wiki prose. Round-range/win-round values not verified.

impoppable.notes: no lives regen; freeplay scaling after 80

standard.rules: no modifiers beyond difficulty; Sandbox set by default

primary_only.rules: only Primary monkeys + hero; otherwise Easy standard (200 lives, towers 85%)
primary_only.unlock: beat Easy Standard on the map

military_only.rules: only Military monkeys (Sniper, Sub, Buccaneer, Ace, Heli, Mortar, Dartling) + hero; sub-mode of Medium

magic_only.rules: only Magic monkeys (Ninja, Wizard, Super, Alchemist, Druid, Mermonkey) + hero

deflation.income: all income disabled except Three Mines crystals; no continues; selling refunds; start round 31

half_cash.rules: all income halved (cash drops, thrives); Monkey Bank rate unchanged

reverse.rules: bloons spawn from exit and exit at entrance; reverse medal

apopalypse.rules: randomized waves, no break; next round starts when prior round's bloons all sent

double_hp_moabs.rules: all MOAB-class HP x2 (stacks with fortified); MOAB 400, BFB 1400

chimps.rules: no continues, hearts lost, income, Monkey Knowledge, powers, selling; start round 6
